title: fix(app-shell): a metadata form row hidden by visibleWhen stays drawn while its key holds a value
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoF2KJYMZv7gd4P381z5gFCd)_

Fixes #38121

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 搭建者在工作室表单里改了某个选项、让一栏按条件隐藏时，如果这一栏已经填了值，它不再消失，而是留在原处，标明「当前设置下不生效，保存可能被拒」，旁边有一个「清除值」按钮；点了才清掉，清掉后这一栏照常隐藏。
- 替在工作室里写钩子的搭建者解决：先在 JavaScript 钩子里填了拒绝码，再改成表达式，保存被拒在一栏看不见的地方、不知道怎么改。做法照你 8 月定的「值保留、作者自己清除」。
- 只影响工作室表单怎么显示已有的值，元数据能写什么不变；所有按条件隐藏的栏都按这个规则来，出问题最多是多显示一栏带提示的栏，可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx`: one gate, `rowGate`, decides every `visibleWhen` row: `shown` (no predicate, or true), `hidden` (false and the key holds no value, or a value equal to the row's JSON schema `default`, compared structurally with `sameJsonValue`, so a parse-filled default such as FieldSchema `multiple: false` is not re-shown as the author's value), `retained` (false but the key holds a value). The three row filters read it: the sectioned body's `visibleFields`, the flat body's `flatFormRowKeys` (which also places a nested form's issues), and a record entry's sub-fields. A `retained` row is drawn with a notice (`data-testid="schema-form-inactive-retained"`, `role="note"`) and, when editable, a "Clear value" button that commits `undefined`, the ordinary clear, which removes the key. Once cleared the row is `hidden` like any other.
  - Ruling followed: objectui#6499 (maintainer, 2026-08-27, Option C), the stored-value re-show rule the flow node inspector's `isFieldVisible` keeps: "a hidden-but-stored dependent value is KEPT: the author sees it and clears it deliberately. Deleting it on save is the rejected option". The card's original Ask (clear on hide, or drop on save) was corrected to this on the card (Premise corrected, comment 7233313649).
  - Section-level `visibleWhen` is unchanged (out of scope per the claim).
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/storedValue.ts` (new): `isUnsetFieldValue` (`undefined`, `null`, `''`) moved here from `inspectors/flow-node-config.ts`, unchanged, so `SchemaForm` and the flow inspector call a key unset in the same words without `SchemaForm` importing from `inspectors/`. `flow-node-config.ts` and `FlowNodeConfigField.tsx` import it from the new module.
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts`, `zh.ts`: `engine.form.inactiveRetained` and `engine.form.inactiveRetainedClear`.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

## Tests
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.hiddenRowRetained-38121.test.tsx`: the real `MetadataResourceEditPage` with the served `hookForm` and the served derivation of `HookSchema`; the client's `save` is `HookSchema` itself, refusing with a real parsed `MetadataError`.
  - (a) fill a refusal through the key-only control on a `js` hook, switch Language to Expression: the `Refusals` row is still drawn with the notice; Clear value hides it; Save sends a body with no `refusals` key, which `HookSchema` accepts.
  - (b) CONTROL: the same without clearing: the refusal reaches the server, and its line is drawn on the visible `Refusals` row, beside the notice.
  - (c) CONTROL: a `js` hook with no refusals switched to Expression: `Refusals` and `Texts` stay hidden, no notice.
  - (d) the real served object form (`METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY.object` plus the served `object` schema). (d-1) CONTROL: the served `fields` entry schema declares `multiple.default === false`. (d-2) `multiple: false` on a `text` field draws no notice. (d-3) CONTROL: `multiple: true` on a `text` field draws the notice.

## Acceptance notes
- Every shipped `visibleWhen` row now follows the rule, not only the hook's two: a row that holds a value under a predicate that has turned false is shown with the notice (for example the action form's `refusals` / `texts` rows after a switch away from `script`).
- No existing test changed: none asserted that a row holding a value is hidden (the 806-file run above).

## Verification
Read first (by risk):
1. `SchemaForm.tsx`: `rowGate` and its three callers, then the `retainedNotice` block in `FieldRow`.
2. The new test file, case (a).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.hiddenRowRetained-38121.test.tsx` shows 3 passing; change `rowGate`'s last line to `return 'hidden';` and (a) and (b) fail.
